2026-02-01.text: It is honorable for a man to refrain from a dispute, but every fool will become embroiled in it.

2026-02-02.text: He will send out the angels and will gather his chosen ones together from the four winds, from earth’s extremity to heaven’s extremity

2026-02-03.text: It is as a free gift that they are being declared righteous by his undeserved kindness through the release by the ransom paid by Christ Jesus.

2026-02-04.text: There is going to be a resurrection of both the righteous and the unrighteous.

2026-02-05.text: Keep on . . . seeking first the Kingdom and his righteousness, and all these other things will be added to you.

2026-02-06.text: We should no longer be children.

2026-02-07.text: O Jehovah, who may be a guest in your tent?

2026-02-08.text: We mustered up boldness by means of our God.

2026-02-09.text: She began taking of its fruit and eating it. Afterward, she also gave some to her husband when he was with her, and he began eating it.

2026-02-10.text: Make sure of the more important things.

2026-02-11.text: Each one will carry his own load.

2026-02-12.text: When anxieties overwhelmed me, you comforted and soothed me.

2026-02-13.text: Will not God cause justice to be done for his chosen ones who cry out to him day and night, while he is patient toward them? I tell you, he will cause justice to be done to them speedily

2026-02-17.text: [Saul] then got up and was baptized.

2026-02-18.text: The way I am running is not aimlessly

2026-02-19.text: Be obedient to those who are taking the lead among you.

2026-02-20.text: He will separate people one from another.

2026-02-21.text: Jehovah is alive! Praised be my Rock! Let the God of my salvation be exalted.

2026-02-22.text: The path of the righteous is like the bright morning light that grows brighter and brighter until full daylight.

2026-02-23.text: Jehovah . . . is patient with you because he does not desire anyone to be destroyed but desires all to attain to repentance.

2026-02-24.text: Let your way of life be free of the love of money.

2026-02-25.text: Let the one who thinks he is standing beware that he does not fall.

2026-02-28.text: Make sure of all things; hold fast to what is fine.
